#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll INF = 1LL << 60;

// Forward declarations
struct Edge;
class Graph;
class MinCostFlow;

// Pair class
template<typename U, typename V>
struct Pair {
    U first;
    V second;
    Pair(U f, V s) : first(f), second(s) {}
    bool operator<(const Pair& o) const {
        if (first != o.first) return first < o.first;
        return second < o.second;
    }
};

// IntegerUtils
struct IntegerUtils {
    static int longCompare(ll a, ll b) {
        if (a < b) return -1;
        if (a > b) return 1;
        return 0;
    }
};

// Edge structure
struct Edge {
    int id;
    Edge(int id) : id(id) {}
};

// Graph class
class Graph {
public:
    static const int REMOVED_BIT = 0;
    int vertexCount;
    int edgeCount;
    vector<int> firstOutbound;
    vector<int> firstInbound;
    vector<Edge*> edges;
    vector<int> nextInbound;
    vector<int> nextOutbound;
    vector<int> from;
    vector<int> to;
    vector<ll> weight;
    vector<ll> capacity;
    vector<int> reverseEdge;
    vector<int> flags;

    Graph(int vertexCount, int edgeCapacity = -1) {
        if (edgeCapacity == -1) edgeCapacity = vertexCount;
        this->vertexCount = vertexCount;
        firstOutbound.assign(vertexCount, -1);
        from.reserve(edgeCapacity);
        to.reserve(edgeCapacity);
        nextOutbound.reserve(edgeCapacity);
        flags.reserve(edgeCapacity);
    }

    int addEdge(int fromID, int toID, ll weight, ll capacity, int reverseEdge) {
        ensureEdgeCapacity(edgeCount + 1);
        if (firstOutbound[fromID] != -1) {
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = firstOutbound[fromID];
        } else {
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = -1;
        }
        firstOutbound[fromID] = edgeCount;
        if (!firstInbound.empty()) {
            if (firstInbound[toID] != -1) {
                nextInbound[edgeCount] = firstInbound[toID];
            } else {
                nextInbound[edgeCount] = -1;
            }
            firstInbound[toID] = edgeCount;
        }
        this->from[edgeCount] = fromID;
        this->to[edgeCount] = toID;
        if (capacity != 0) {
            this->capacity[edgeCount] = capacity;
        }
        if (weight != 0) {
            this->weight[edgeCount] = weight;
        }
        if (reverseEdge != -1) {
            this->reverseEdge[edgeCount] = reverseEdge;
        }
        return edgeCount++;
    }

    int addFlowWeightedEdge(int from, int to, ll weight, ll capacity) {
        if (capacity == 0) {
            return addEdge(from, to, weight, 0, -1);
        } else {
            int lastEdgeCount = edgeCount;
            addEdge(to, from, -weight, 0, lastEdgeCount + 1);
            return addEdge(from, to, weight, capacity, lastEdgeCount);
        }
    }

    int vertexCount() const { return vertexCount; }

    int firstOutbound(int vertex) {
        int id = firstOutbound[vertex];
        while (id != -1 && isRemoved(id)) {
            id = nextOutbound[id];
        }
        return id;
    }

    int nextOutbound(int id) {
        id = nextOutbound[id];
        while (id != -1 && isRemoved(id)) {
            id = nextOutbound[id];
        }
        return id;
    }

    int source(int id) { return from[id]; }
    int destination(int id) { return to[id]; }
    ll weight(int id) { return weight.empty() ? 0 : weight[id]; }
    ll capacity(int id) { return capacity.empty() ? 0 : capacity[id]; }
    ll flow(int id) {
        if (reverseEdge.empty()) return 0;
        return capacity[reverseEdge[id]];
    }

    void pushFlow(int id, ll flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return;
        if (flow > 0) {
            if (capacity(id) < flow) throw invalid_argument("Not enough capacity");
        } else {
            if (flow(id) < -flow) throw invalid_argument("Not enough capacity");
        }
        capacity[id] -= flow;
        capacity[reverseEdge[id]] += flow;
    }

    bool flag(int id, int bit) {
        return (flags[id] >> bit & 1) != 0;
    }

    bool isRemoved(int id) {
        return flag(id, REMOVED_BIT);
    }

    bool isSparse() {
        return vertexCount == 0 || edgeCount * 20 / vertexCount <= vertexCount;
    }

protected:
    void ensureEdgeCapacity(int size) {
        while ((int)from.size() < size) {
            int newSize = max(size, 2 * (int)from.size());
            from.resize(newSize);
            to.resize(newSize);
            nextOutbound.resize(newSize);
            if (!nextInbound.empty()) nextInbound.resize(newSize);
            if (!weight.empty()) weight.resize(newSize);
            if (!capacity.empty()) capacity.resize(newSize);
            if (!reverseEdge.empty()) reverseEdge.resize(newSize);
            flags.resize(newSize);
        }
    }
};

// MinCostFlow class
class MinCostFlow {
public:
    Graph& graph;
    int source;
    int destination;
    vector<ll> phi;
    vector<ll> dijkstraResult;
    vector<int> lastEdge;
    // Heap simplified using priority_queue
    int vertexCount;

    MinCostFlow(Graph& graph, int source, int destination, bool hasNegativeEdges)
        : graph(graph), source(source), destination(destination) {
        vertexCount = graph.vertexCount();
        phi.assign(vertexCount, 0);
        if (hasNegativeEdges) {
            fordBellman();
        }
        dijkstraResult.assign(vertexCount, 0);
        lastEdge.assign(vertexCount, -1);
    }

    void fordBellman() {
        fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), INF);
        phi[source] = 0;
        vector<bool> inQueue(vertexCount, false);
        vector<int> queue(vertexCount + 1);
        queue[0] = source;
        inQueue[source] = true;
        int head = 0, end = 1;
        int maxSteps = 2 * vertexCount * vertexCount;
        int stepCount = 0;
        while (head != end) {
            int vertex = queue[head++];
            if (head == (int)queue.size()) head = 0;
            inQueue[vertex] = false;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(vertex);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                ll total = phi[vertex] + graph.weight(edgeID);
                int dest = graph.destination(edgeID);
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0 && phi[dest] > total) {
                    phi[dest] = total;
                    if (!inQueue[dest]) {
                        queue[end++] = dest;
                        inQueue[dest] = true;
                        if (end == (int)queue.size()) end = 0;
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
            if (++stepCount > maxSteps) {
                throw invalid_argument("Graph contains negative cycle");
            }
        }
    }

    static Pair<ll, ll> minCostMaxFlow(Graph& graph, int source, int destination,
                                        bool hasNegativeEdges, ll maxFlow) {
        MinCostFlow mcf(graph, source, destination, hasNegativeEdges);
        return mcf.minCostMaxFlow(maxFlow);
    }

    Pair<ll, ll> minCostMaxFlow(ll maxFlow) {
        ll cost = 0, flow = 0;
        while (maxFlow != 0) {
            if (graph.isSparse()) {
                dijkstraAlgorithm();
            } else {
                dijkstraAlgorithmFull();
            }
            if (lastEdge[destination] == -1) {
                return Pair<ll, ll>(cost, flow);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)dijkstraResult.size(); i++) {
                if (dijkstraResult[i] != INF) {
                    phi[i] += dijkstraResult[i];
                }
            }
            int vertex = destination;
            ll currentFlow = maxFlow;
            ll currentCost = 0;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                currentFlow = min(currentFlow, graph.capacity(edgeID));
                currentCost += graph.weight(edgeID);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
            maxFlow -= currentFlow;
            cost += currentCost * currentFlow;
            flow += currentFlow;
            vertex = destination;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                graph.pushFlow(edgeID, currentFlow);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
        }
        return Pair<ll, ll>(cost, flow);
    }

private:
    struct CompareDist {
        bool operator()(const pair<ll, int>& a, const pair<ll, int>& b) const {
            return a.first > b.first;
        }
    };

    void dijkstraAlgorithm() {
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), INF);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        priority_queue<pair<ll, int>, vector<pair<ll, int>>, CompareDist> pq;
        pq.push({0, source});
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [dist, current] = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            if (dist != dijkstraResult[current]) continue;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(current);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int next = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    ll total = graph.weight(edgeID) - phi[next] + phi[current] + dijkstraResult[current];
                    if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                        dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                        lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                        pq.push({total, next});
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithmFull() {
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), INF);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        vector<bool> used(vertexCount, false);
        for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
            int v = -1;
            for (int j = 0; j < vertexCount; j++) {
                if (!used[j] && (v == -1 || dijkstraResult[j] < dijkstraResult[v])) {
                    v = j;
                }
            }
            if (v == -1 || dijkstraResult[v] == INF) break;
            used[v] = true;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(v);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int to = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    if (!used[to]) {
                        ll total = graph.weight(edgeID) - phi[to] + phi[v] + dijkstraResult[v];
                        if (dijkstraResult[to] > total) {
                            dijkstraResult[to] = total;
                            lastEdge[to] = edgeID;
                        }
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }
};

// InputReader simplified
class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader() {}
    int readInt() {
        int x = 0, f = 1; char ch = getchar();
        while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') { if (ch == '-') f = -1; ch = getchar(); }
        while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') { x = x * 10 + ch - '0'; ch = getchar(); }
        return x * f;
    }
    string readString() {
        char ch = getchar();
        while (ch == ' ' || ch == '\n' || ch == '\r' || ch == '\t') ch = getchar();
        string res;
        while (ch != ' ' && ch != '\n' && ch != '\r' && ch != '\t' && ch != EOF) {
            res.push_back(ch);
            ch = getchar();
        }
        return res;
    }
};

// TaskF
class TaskF {
public:
    int n;
    string s;
    vector<int> ugliness;

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in) {
        n = in.readInt();
        s = in.readString();
        ugliness.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            ugliness[i] = -in.readInt();
        }

        Graph graph(1 + 26 + n / 2 + 1);
        for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; ++c) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
                int cost = 0;
                if (c == s[i]) {
                    cost = min(cost, ugliness[i]);
                }
                if (c == s[n - 1 - i]) {
                    cost = min(cost, ugliness[n - 1 - i]);
                }
                graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(1 + (c - 'a'), 1 + 26 + i, cost, 1);
            }
        }

        vector<int> occurs(128, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) occurs[s[i]]++;
        for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; ++c) {
            graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(0, 1 + (c - 'a'), 0, occurs[c]);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
            graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(1 + 26 + i, 1 + 26 + n / 2, 0, 2);
        }

        Pair<ll, ll> flow = MinCostFlow::minCostMaxFlow(graph, 0, 1 + 26 + n / 2, true, n);
        cout << -flow.first << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    InputReader in;
    TaskF solver;
    solver.solve(1, in);
    return 0;
}
